info.name: Argon Backend API
info.description:
# Argon Backend API

Multi-tenant, AI-assisted customer support and lead engagement platform.

## Getting started

1. Set the `base_url` collection variable (default `http://localhost:8007`, the WSGI dev port).
2. Run **Accounts → Login** (or **Register** then **Verify OTP**). Access/refresh tokens are saved automatically to collection variables.
3. Authenticated requests send `Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}` automatically via collection-level auth. Public endpoints disable it.

## Conventions

- **Response envelope** — every endpoint returns:
  ```json
  {"status": 200, "success": true, "message": "...", "data": {}, "meta": {}, "errors": {}}
  ```
  `meta` and `errors` are present when applicable. Validation failures return HTTP 400 with an `errors` object.
- **Pagination** — list endpoints accept `page` and `page_size` (default 20, max 100) and return `meta: {count, page, page_size, num_pages, next, previous}`.
- **Object scoping via query params** — dashboard endpoints resolve the target object from query parameters (`workspace`, `chatbot`, `chatbot_slug`, `session_id`, `knowledge_base_id`, `lead_id`, `appointment_id`, `transfer_id`), not from the URL path. Note: chat endpoints use `chatbot_slug`, while knowledge/subscription endpoints use `chatbot`.
- **Auth** — SimpleJWT Bearer tokens. Access tokens last 24h, refresh tokens 7d (rotated + blacklisted on refresh). Login endpoints return `access_token`/`refresh_token`; the refresh endpoint returns `access`/`refresh`.
- **URL layout** — REST: `/api/v1/...`, platform admin: `/api/v1/admin/...`, Django admin: `/admin/`, WebSockets (separate ASGI process, port 8008): `/ws/...`.
- All paths require a trailing slash.

## Permissions

Workspace roles: `ADMIN`, `MEMBER`. Chatbot memberships carry granular permissions (e.g. `setup_configuration`, `chat_session_management`, `lead_management`, `appointment_management`) or `all_permissions`. Chatbot/workspace admins bypass permission checks. Platform admin endpoints require `is_staff`; superadmin endpoints require `is_superuser`.

item.name: Accounts
item.description: Identity and account lifecycle: registration, email verification (OTP), JWT login, Google/Firebase login, password reset, profile and settings. Base path: `/api/v1/accounts/`.

request.description:
Create a new user account. **Public.**

**Body** (JSON): `email` (email, required), `password` (min 8, required), `confirm_password` (must match, required), `name` (≤50, optional), `phone` (optional, `+?digits 6-15`).

**201** → `data`: user object (`id, email, name, provider, status, is_email_verified, is_active, phone, avatar_url, city, country, timezone, created_at, updated_at, last_login`). An OTP is emailed for verification.

Verify the 4-digit OTP sent by email and receive JWT tokens. **Public.**

**Body**: `email` (required), `otp` (4 digits, required).

Email/password login. **Public.** Saves tokens to collection variables automatically.

**Body**: `email` (required), `password` (required).

**200** → `data: {access_token, refresh_token}`. Rejects disabled/suspended users and unverified password-provider emails.

Sign in / sign up with a Firebase ID token. **Public.**

**Body**: `firebase_id_token` (required, verified server-side), `provider` (`"google"`, default), `email`, `email_verified`, `name`, `photo_url`, `phone_number`, `firebase_uid` (only if the token cannot be decoded server-side).

**200** → `data: {access_token, refresh_token}`.

Rotate JWT pair. Old refresh token is blacklisted. **Public.**

**Body**: `refresh` (required).

**200** → `data: {access, refresh}` (note the simplejwt key names; the test script maps them to `access_token` / `refresh_token`).

Send a password reset link by email. **Public.** Always returns a generic message (no user enumeration).

**Body**: `email` (required).

Complete a password reset using the emailed `uid` + `token`. **Public.**

**Body**: `uid`, `token`, `new_password` (min 8), `confirm_password` — all required.

Current user's profile. **Auth required.**

**200** → `data`: full user object (`id, email, name, provider, status, is_email_verified, phone, avatar_url, city, country, timezone, created_at, updated_at, last_login`).

Update the current user's profile (all fields optional). **Auth required.** Accepts JSON or `multipart/form-data`.

**Fields**: `name`, `phone`, `country` (≤100), `city` (≤100), `timezone` (IANA name), `profile_picture` (image file → Cloudflare R2), `clear_profile_picture` (bool, exclusive with `profile_picture`).

formdata.description: Set true to remove the current avatar

request.description:
Change password for the logged-in user. **Auth required.**

**Body**: `current_password`, `new_password` (min 8, must differ), `confirm_password` — all required.

Soft-delete the current account. **Auth required.**

**200** → `data: {deleted_at}`.

item.name: Workspaces
item.description: Multi-tenant workspaces and member management. Base path: `/api/v1/workspaces/`. Requires an active workspace membership; admin operations require the workspace ADMIN role (owner is always ADMIN).

request.description:
Retrieve a workspace. If `workspace` is omitted, returns the first workspace where the caller is owner/active member.

**Query**: `workspace` (slug, optional).

**200** → `data`: `{id, name, slug, logo, industry, owner {id, email, name}, member_count, current_user_role, is_active, created_at, updated_at}`.

Paginated list of the caller's workspaces.

**Query**: `page`, `page_size`.

**200** → `data`: workspace list + `meta`.

Create a workspace (caller becomes owner). Accepts JSON or multipart (logo).

**Body**: `name` (required, ≤120), `industry` (≤100, optional), `logo` (image, optional), `clear_logo` (bool, optional). Saves the new slug to `workspace`.

Update a workspace. **Owner only** (403 otherwise). Supports PUT and PATCH.

**Query**: `workspace` (slug, required).

**Body**: same fields as create (all optional on PATCH).

Soft-delete a workspace. Requires workspace **ADMIN**.

**Query**: `workspace` (slug, required).

item.name: Team
item.description: Workspace members, invitations, and roles.

request.description:
Paginated members, including pending invitations (synthesized rows).

**Query**: `workspace` (slug, required), `page`, `page_size`.

**200** → `data`: `{id, user {email, name, avatar}, role, is_active, invitation_request_accepted, last_active, last_login, invited_at, created_at, updated_at}`.

Details of one membership.

**Query**: `workspace` (slug, required), `member_email` (email, required).

Email a workspace invitation. **Owner only.**

**Query**: `workspace` (slug, required).

**Body**: `email` (required).

**201** → `data: {id, workspace, email, expires_at, created_at}`.

Change a member's role. Requires workspace **ADMIN**. Owner must remain ADMIN. Supports GET (view) and PATCH.

**Query**: `workspace`, `member_email` (both required).

**Body**: `role` (`ADMIN` | `MEMBER`).

Accept a workspace invitation with the emailed token. **Authenticated user only** (no prior membership needed); the user's email must match the invitation.

**Body**: `token` (required).

Remove a member from a workspace. Requires workspace **ADMIN**. The owner cannot be removed (400).

**Query**: `workspace`, `member_email` (both required).

item.name: Chatbots
item.description: Chatbot configuration, widget settings, teams, and the public visitor/widget API. Base path: `/api/v1/chatbots/`. Most dashboard endpoints resolve the chatbot from the `chatbot` query param (slug) and require an active chatbot membership (or workspace admin).

request.description:
Create a chatbot inside a workspace. Caller must be an active member of that workspace. Accepts JSON or multipart (logo).

**Body (key fields)**: one of `workspace` (uuid-or-slug) / `workspace_id` / `workspace_slug` (required on create), `chatbot_name` (≤120, required, unique per workspace), `business_name`, `description`, `welcome_message`, `fallback_message`, `instructions`, `escalation_rule`, `never_answer`, `language` (default `en`), `timezone` (default `UTC`), `ai_enabled`, `knowledge_base_enabled`, `human_handoff_enabled`, `other_settings` (JSON), `status`, `logo` (image), `clear_logo` (bool).

**201** → `data`: full chatbot incl. `id`, `slug`, `workspace {id, name, slug}`, `member_count`, `current_user_role`.

formdata.description: Workspace slug, uuid, or use workspace_id/workspace_slug

request.description:
Paginated chatbots visible to the caller.

**Query**: `workspace` (slug, optional filter), `page`, `page_size`.

**200** → `data`: `{slug, workspace {id, name, slug}, chatbot_name, business_name, description, ai_enabled, logo, status, current_user_role, subscription_plan_name, created_by {name, email, avatar}, members [{name, avatar}]}`.

Overview for the chatbot dashboard: features, capacity/limits, and current subscription.

**Query**: `chatbot` (slug, required).

**200** → `data`: `{workspace {name, slug}, chatbot_name, slug, language, timezone, features {knowledge_base_enabled, human_handoff_enabled, appointment_booking_enabled, lead_captures_enabled}, capacity {ai_message_limit, current_ai_message_count, test_ai_message_limit, current_test_ai_message_count, file_size_limit_bytes, current_file_size_bytes, knowledge_chunk_limit, current_knowledge_chunk_count, active_features}, current_subscription_plan {...}|null, ai_enabled, logo, status, allowed_urls [{id, url, is_active}]}`.

Full chatbot configuration.

**Query**: `chatbot` (slug, required).

Embeddable widget configuration, including the `public_key` used by the public API. Saves `public_key` to the collection variables.

**Query**: `chatbot` (slug, required).

**200** → `data`: `{id, chatbot_name, business_name, description, slug, logo, welcome_message, status, widget_settings {id, is_enabled, public_key, primary_color, secondary_color, launcher_position, launcher_text, header_title, header_description, show_branding, theme, other_settings, ...}, allowed_urls [{id, url, is_active}]}`.

Update widget settings and allowed origins. Requires the `setup_configuration` chatbot permission. Supports PUT and PATCH; at least one key required.

**Query**: `chatbot` (slug, required).

**Body**: `widget_settings` (object: `is_enabled`, `primary_color`, `secondary_color`, `launcher_position`, `launcher_text`, `header_title`, `header_description`, `show_branding`, `theme`, `other_settings`), `allowed_urls` (list of `{id? | url?, is_active?}` — `id` or `url` required per item), `removed_allowed_url_id` (uuid).

Update chatbot configuration. Requires the `setup_configuration` permission. Workspace fields cannot be changed (400). Supports PUT and PATCH.

**Query**: `chatbot` (slug, required).

**Body**: any writable field from create (e.g. `chatbot_name`, `instructions`, `welcome_message`, `ai_enabled`, ...).

Soft-delete a chatbot (status → DISABLED). Requires workspace ADMIN or chatbot ADMIN.

**Query**: `chatbot` (slug, required).

item.name: Team
item.description: Chatbot members, permissions, and invitations. Base path: `/api/v1/chatbots/team/`.

request.description:
Paginated chatbot members incl. pending invitations.

**Query**: `chatbot` (slug, required), `page`, `page_size`.

**200** → `data`: `{id, user {email, name, avatar}, role, permissions, all_permissions, is_active, last_active, last_login, invited_at, created_at, updated_at}`.

One membership with effective permissions.

**Query**: `chatbot`, `member_email` (both required).

Invite a member by email with optional permissions (defaults apply).

**Query**: `chatbot` (slug, required).

**Body**: `email` (required), `permissions` (list of permission strings, optional).

**201** → `data: {id, chatbot, chatbot_name, email, permissions, invited_at, expires_at, created_at}`.

Replace a member's permission list. Requires chatbot ADMIN (or workspace ADMIN). Supports GET (view) and PATCH.

**Query**: `chatbot`, `member_email` (both required).

**Body**: `permissions` (list, required; may be empty).

Accept a chatbot invitation. If the invited email has no account yet, include signup fields and JWT tokens are returned.

**Body**: `token` (required); for new users also `name`, `password` (min 8), `confirm_password`.

Remove a chatbot membership (hard delete). Requires workspace ADMIN or chatbot ADMIN.

**Query**: `chatbot`, `member_email` (both required).

item.name: Public Widget API
item.description: Visitor-facing endpoints for the embeddable widget. **No JWT auth** — the chatbot is addressed by its `public_key` (see Widget Details). The `Origin` header must match the chatbot's allowed widget origins. Conversation actions after creation require `Authorization: Bearer <conversation_token>`.

request.description:
Bootstrap data for the widget. **Public.**

**200** → `data`: `{chatbot_name, logo, language, welcome_message, widget_settings {colors, launcher, header, theme, ...}, lead_config|null {is_enabled, collectable_fields, auto_collect, require_consent, consent_message}, appointment_config|null {collectable_fields, confirmation_message}}`.

Start a new conversation or resume one via `conversation_token`. Saves `conversation_token`, `session_id`, and `visitor_id` automatically. **Public** (Origin check).

**Body**: `conversation_token` (optional — resume), `user_metadata` (JSON), `metadata` (JSON), `lead_id` (uuid) XOR `lead_data` (JSON).

**201** (new) / **200** (resumed) → `data: {session {id, visitor_id, status, ai_enabled}, conversation_token, websocket_url, resumed, messages [...]}`.

Send a visitor message. AI reply is generated asynchronously (WebSocket / polling). **Auth: `Bearer {{conversation_token}}`** (not the account JWT) + Origin check.

**Body**: `content` (≤10000, required, non-blank), `client_message_id` (idempotency key, optional), `metadata` (JSON).

**201** → `data: {message, duplicate, ai_queued}`. **409** on idempotency conflict.

Book an appointment from the widget. **Auth: `Bearer {{conversation_token}}`** + Origin check.

**Body**: `starts_at` (ISO-8601 **with explicit UTC offset**, required), `collected_fields` (JSON, optional).

**201** → `data: {appointment {id, collected_fields, starts_at, ends_at, status, created_at}, duplicate, agent_acknowledged, agent_reply}`. **409** on booking validation failure.

Public visitor profile. **Public** (Origin check).

**200** → `data: {visitor_id, lead_id|null, lead_data, user_metadata}`.

Conversation history for a visitor. **Public** (Origin check).

**200** → `data`: list of `{id, status, last_activity_at, last_message {content, sender}|null}`.

item.name: Chat (Dashboard)
item.description: Agent-facing conversation management: sessions, messages, human takeover, transfers, and session analytics. Base path: `/api/v1/chat/`. Requires chatbot membership with the `chat_session_management` permission. **All endpoints use the `chatbot_slug` query param.**

request.description:
Paginated chat sessions.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug` (required), `search` (matches message content or visitor name/email), `assigned_to` (chatbot-member email; matches current ownership or a live pending transfer request), `status` (`open|resolved|closed`), `assignment` (`all|mine|assigned|unassigned`, default `all`), `my_session` (bool), `requires_attention` (bool), `is_recently_active` (bool — active in last 10 min), `page`, `page_size`.

**200** → `data`: `{id, channel (web_widget|messenger|instagram|whatsapp|api), user_data {name, detected_country}, unread_message_count, last_message {sender, content}|null, ai_enabled, is_recently_active, status, assigned_to {name}|null, transfer_requested_to {name}|null, requires_attention, attention_reason, last_activity_at}`.

query.description: Optional: message content or visitor name/email
Optional: current assignee or pending transfer recipient email

request.description:
Full session record.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug`, `session_id` (both required).

Mark visitor messages in the session as read.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug`, `session_id`.

**200** → `data: {marked_read_count}`.

Hard-delete a session.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug`, `session_id`.

Paginated messages of a session.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug`, `session_id`, `page`, `page_size`.

**200** → `data`: `{id, chat_session_id, sender_type (visitor|ai|agent|system), sender {id, name, email, avatar_url}|null, content, status (sent|delivered|read|failed), external_id, metadata, attachments [{id, attachment_type, file_url, file_name, mime_type, file_size, duration_ms, sort_order, created_at}], created_at, updated_at}`.

Send a message as the logged-in agent.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug`, `session_id`.

**Body**: `content` (≤10000, required), `metadata` (JSON, optional).

**201** → `data`: created message.

item.name: Takeovers
item.description: Human takeover lifecycle: an agent takes over an AI session, releases it, resolves/closes, or reopens.

request.description:
Take over the session from the AI.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug`, `session_id`.

**201** → `data`: takeover object `{id, chat_session_id, agent {...}, released_at, release_reason (transferred|resolved|closed|released|forced_takeover|forced_release), released_to, resolution_note, reopened_at, created_at, updated_at}`.

Release the session back to the AI.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug`, `session_id`.

Force-release another agent's active takeover and return the open session to AI. Requires chat-session management permission.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug`, `session_id`.

**Body**: `note` (required, non-blank, ≤5000).

Resolve or close the session.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug`, `session_id`.

**Body**: `resolution_type` (`resolved` | `closed`, required), `note` (≤5000, optional).

Reopen a resolved/closed session.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug`, `session_id`.

item.name: Transfers
item.description: Agent-to-agent session transfers.

request.description:
Transfer a session to another agent (must be an active member of the same chatbot).

**Query**: `chatbot_slug`, `session_id`.

**Body**: `to_agent_id` (uuid, required), `reason` (≤5000, optional), `expires_at` (datetime, optional).

**201** → `data`: transfer `{id, chat_session_id, from_agent, to_agent, status (pending|accepted|declined|cancelled|expired), reason, completed_at, expires_at, ...}`.

Transfers addressed to the caller (expired pending ones are lazily expired first).

**Query**: `chatbot_slug` (required), `status` (`pending|accepted|declined|cancelled|expired`, optional), `page`, `page_size`.

Accept an incoming transfer.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug`, `transfer_id` (both required).

Decline an incoming transfer.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug`, `transfer_id`.

Cancel a transfer you requested.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug`, `transfer_id`.

Totals for the chatbot.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug` (required).

**200** → `data`: `{total_sessions, total_messages, sessions_last_30_days, messages_last_30_days, session_percentage_change, message_percentage_change}` (change vs previous 30-day window).

Daily session counts over a date range (zero-filled continuous series; default last 14 days).

**Query**: `chatbot_slug` (required), `start_date` (`YYYY-MM-DD`, optional), `end_date` (optional; start > end → 400).

item.name: Knowledge
item.description: Knowledge source ingestion, retrieval, and asynchronous training. Base path: `/api/v1/knowledge/`. Most endpoints use the **`chatbot`** query param (slug); search accepts `chatbotSlug` in its JSON body. Upload/update/search require the `setup_configuration` permission; delete requires chatbot/workspace admin. Training runs asynchronously — poll `training-logs/` or the `status` field (`pending|processing|ready|failed`).

request.description:
Add a knowledge source. **Query**: `chatbot` (slug, required), `type` (`file` | `url` | `custom`, required).

- `type=file` → **multipart/form-data** with `file` (allowed: pdf, docx, xlsx, csv, xml, json; size/entitlement limits) and optional `title`.
- `type=url` → JSON: `url` (public http/https, DNS-resolvable, non-private IP), `title`.
- `type=custom` → JSON: `content` (text, word-count limited), `title`.

**201** → `data: {knowledge_base, training}`. **403** if the plan lacks the knowledge feature.

(Switch the body mode in Postman for the `file` variant.)

File upload variant — uses `multipart/form-data`.

**Query**: `chatbot` (slug), `type=file`.

**Form fields**: `file` (pdf, docx, xlsx, csv, xml, or json), `title` (optional).

formdata.description: Required — pdf, docx, xlsx, csv, xml, json

request.description:
Paginated knowledge sources for a chatbot (newest first).

**Query**: `chatbot` (required), `page`, `page_size`.

**200** → `data`: `{id, name, url, source_type (file|website|text), file_type, file_size, is_enabled, status (pending|processing|ready|failed), last_crawled_at, processed_at, created_at, updated_at}`.

Return up to 10 ranked retrieval chunks from enabled knowledge sources belonging to the requested chatbot. This endpoint performs hybrid vector/full-text retrieval only and does not call an LLM.

**JSON body**: `chatbotSlug` (required), `query` (required, non-blank, max 2,000 characters).

Entitlement usage for the chatbot.

**Query**: `chatbot` (required).

**200** → `data: {total_chunks, chunk_limit, total_file_size_bytes, file_size_limit_bytes, file_size_limit_mb}`.

Full knowledge-source record incl. signed `file_url` (private R2 link) and latest training log.

**Query**: `knowledge_base_id` (uuid, required — no `chatbot` param needed).

Update a knowledge source; metadata-only or retrain. Supports PUT and PATCH.

**Query**: `knowledge_base_id` (uuid, required), `type` (`file|url|custom`, must match the source's type).

**Body**: `title`, `is_enabled`; for `custom` also `content` (triggers retraining; 409 if training active). Empty body: `url` sources always re-crawl; `file` sources retrain only when status is `failed`.

**200** (metadata) → `data`: knowledge object; **202** → `data: {knowledge_base, training}` when retraining is queued.

Delete a knowledge source. Requires chatbot admin or workspace admin. **409** while a training job is active.

**Query**: `knowledge_base_id` (uuid, required).

Paginated training jobs for a chatbot (newest first).

**Query**: `chatbot` (required), `page`, `page_size`.

**200** → `data`: `{id, knowledge_base_id, celery_task_id, stage (queued|extracting|chunking|embedding|indexing|...), progress, total_chunks, processed_chunks, force_retrain, content_changed, message, error_message, started_at, completed_at, ...}`.

item.name: Lead Capture
item.description: Configurable in-chat lead collection, lead management, and lead notes. Base path: `/api/v1/lead-captures/`. Uses the **`chatbot_slug`** query param. Config endpoints require `setup_configuration`; lead/note endpoints require `lead_management`. The chatbot's plan must include the lead capture feature (else 403).

request.description:
Lead capture configuration. **404** if none exists yet.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug` (required).

**200** → `data`: `{id, chatbot_id, is_enabled, collectable_fields (array of {label, value, mode, type}), auto_collect, require_consent, consent_message, created_at, updated_at}`.

Create the lead capture config. **409** if one already exists.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug`.

**Body**: `is_enabled` (bool), `collectable_fields` (array), `auto_collect` (bool), `require_consent` (bool), `consent_message` — all optional.

Update the lead capture config. Supports PUT and PATCH.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug`.

**Body**: same writable fields as create.

Paginated leads.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug` (required), `page`, `page_size`.

**200** → `data`: `{id, chatbot_id, collected_fields (JSON), initial_ip_address, last_ip_address, detected_country_code, detected_city, status (new|qualified|contacted|converted|disqualified), lead_score (0-100|null), source, notes_count, created_at, updated_at}`.

Download up to 1,000 newest leads as CSV or Excel. Collected fields are flattened into columns. Without dates, all available leads are considered.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug` and `file_format` (`csv`, `xlsx`, or `excel`) are required. `start_date` and `end_date` are optional inclusive dates in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

Single lead.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug`, `lead_id` (both required).

Update lead attributes. Supports PUT and PATCH.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug`, `lead_id`.

**Body**: `collected_fields` (JSON), `status` (choice), `lead_score` (int ≤100), `source`.

Paginated notes for a lead.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug`, `lead_id`, `page`, `page_size`.

**200** → `data`: `{id, lead_id, author {id, name, email}, content, created_at, updated_at}`.

Add a note to a lead.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug`, `lead_id`.

**Body**: `content` (non-empty, required).

Single note.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug`, `lead_id`, `note_id` (all required).

Update a note. Supports PUT and PATCH.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug`, `lead_id`, `note_id`.

**Body**: `content`.

Delete a note.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug`, `lead_id`, `note_id`.

**200** → `data: {id}`.

item.name: Appointment Booking
item.description: Booking configuration, weekly availability schedules, and appointment management. Base path: `/api/v1/appointment-bookings/`. Uses the **`chatbot_slug`** query param. Config/schedule endpoints require `setup_configuration`; appointment endpoints require `appointment_management`. The config is auto-created on first access.

request.description:
Booking configuration (auto-created on first access).

**Query**: `chatbot_slug` (required).

**200** → `data`: `{id, chatbot_id, is_enabled, collectable_fields, appointment_duration_minutes, maximum_advance_days, max_appointments_per_day|null, confirmation_message, created_at, updated_at}`.

Update booking configuration. Supports PUT and PATCH.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug`.

**Body**: `is_enabled`, `collectable_fields`, `appointment_duration_minutes`, `maximum_advance_days`, `max_appointments_per_day`, `confirmation_message`.

item.name: Schedules
item.description: Weekly recurring availability and closed dates.

request.description:
Weekly availability and closed dates.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug` (required).

**200** → `data`: `{schedules: [{id, weekday (0=Mon..6=Sun), is_active, slots: [{id, start_time, end_time, is_active}]}], closed_dates: [{id, date, label, is_active}]}`.

Replace weekly schedules and/or closed dates. Supports PUT and PATCH. Validations: unique weekday, non-overlapping active slots, unique dates.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug`.

**Body**: `schedules` (list of `{weekday, is_active?, slots: [{start_time, end_time, is_active?}]}`), `closed_dates` (list of `{date, label?, is_active?}`).

Paginated appointments.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug` (required), `page`, `page_size`.

**200** → `data`: `{id, chatbot_id, collected_fields, metadata, starts_at, ends_at, status (pending|confirmed|completed|cancelled|no_show), notes, cancellation_reason, created_at, updated_at}`.

Update an appointment. Supports PUT and PATCH.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug`, `appointment_id`.

**Body**: `collected_fields`, `metadata`, `starts_at`, `ends_at`, `status`, `notes`, `cancellation_reason`.

Delete an appointment.

**Query**: `chatbot_slug`, `appointment_id`.

**200** → `data: {id}`.

item.name: Subscriptions
item.description: Plans, entitlements, and Stripe billing lifecycle. Base path: `/api/v1/subscriptions/`. Chatbot-scoped operations use the **`chatbot`** query param (slug); admin-level operations (checkout, activate-free, payments, billing portal, cancellation) require chatbot admin.

request.description:
Public subscription plans.

**200** → `data`: `{id, name, slug, plan_type, ai_message_limit, file_size_limit_mb, knowledge_chunk_limit, ai_message_overage_enabled, features, details_html, is_free, requires_sales_contact, sort_order, prices: [{id, provider, billing_interval, currency, amount, ai_message_overage_unit_price}]}` + `meta: {count}`.

One plan by slug.

**Query**: `plan` (slug, required).

Start or reuse a Stripe checkout session. **Chatbot admin only.**

**Query**: `chatbot` (slug, required).

**Body**: `plan_price_id` (uuid of an active, non-free, non-sales price, required).

**201/200** → `data: {subscription_id, subscription_status, client_secret, requires_checkout, reused, action}`. Errors: 402/409/502/503.

Activate a free (amount 0, public) plan for the chatbot. **Chatbot admin only.**

**Query**: `chatbot`.

**Body**: `plan_price_id` (uuid, required).

**201/200** → `data`: subscription object.

The chatbot's active subscription (any member).

**Query**: `chatbot`.

**200** → `data: {subscription: {...}|null}` with `{id, chatbot_id, plan_price_id, snapshot, provider, renewal_mode, status, started_at, current_period_start, current_period_end, cancel_at_period_end, canceled_at, ended_at, ...}`.

Paginated payments for the chatbot. **Chatbot admin only.**

**Query**: `chatbot`, `page`, `page_size`.

**200** → `data`: `{id, subscription_id, plan_price_id, provider, payment_type, status, billing_interval, amount, amount_refunded, currency, description, provider_reference, failure_code, failure_message, paid_at, refunded_at, invoice_url, invoice_pdf, created_at, updated_at}`.

Get a Stripe billing portal URL. **Chatbot admin only.** Requires an existing Stripe customer (400 otherwise).

**Query**: `chatbot`.

**200** → `data: {portal_url}`.

Cancel the chatbot's subscription. **Chatbot admin only.** Free plans cancel immediately; Stripe plans toggle end-of-period cancellation.

**Query**: `chatbot`.

**Body**: `cancel_at_period_end` (bool, default `true`).

Stripe webhook receiver. **No auth** (signature-verified); send the raw Stripe event body with the `Stripe-Signature` header. Intended for Stripe, not manual use.

**200** → `data: {event_id, duplicate}`.

item.name: Notifications
item.description: Scoped in-app notifications for the logged-in user. Base path: `/api/v1/notifications/`. **Authenticated** (JWT).

request.description:
Paginated notifications with optional filters.

**Query**: `recipient_type` (`global|workspace|chatbot|user|chat_session`), `notification_type` or `type` (`general|update|maintenance|notify|new_message|session_ended|session_started|ai_notification|training_complete`), `workspace_id` (uuid), `chatbot_id` (uuid), `unread_only` (`1|true|yes`), `page`, `page_size`.

**200** → `data`: `{id, recipient_type, notification_type, title, message, metadata, workspace_id, chatbot_id, target_id, is_read, read_at, created_at}`; `meta` adds `unread_count`.

Mark filtered notifications as read (same filters as list).

**200** → `data: {marked_read_count}`.

Mark one notification as read.

**200** → `data: {id, is_read, read_at}`.

item.name: Platform Config
item.description: Public Argon platform configuration (branding, legal docs, features, announcements, SEO).

request.description:
Public platform configuration. Section flags are presence-based; omit all to get every section.

**Query** (all optional): `branding`, `legal_document`, `feature`, `announcement`, `platform_default`, `seo`, `audit`, `document_type` (`privacy_policy|terms_of_service|data_deletion_policy|cookie_policy`).

**200** → `data`: selected sections, e.g. `branding {title, logo, favicon, support_email}`, `feature {is_vectorize_enabled, maintenance_mode}`, `announcement {notify_banner_enabled, notify_banner_text, notify_banner_url}`, `seo {meta_title, meta_description}`, ...

query.description: Optional: limits legal_document to one document

item.name: Platform Admin
item.description: Platform-level administration. Base path: `/api/v1/admin/`. Uses `{{admin_access_token}}` (set automatically by Admin Login) instead of the user token. Most endpoints require `is_staff` (`IsAdmin`) or `is_superuser` (`IsSuperAdmin`).

item.name: Accounts
item.description: Platform staff authentication and user administration.

request.description:
Login for platform staff (`is_staff` required; suspended/deactivated profiles rejected). Saves tokens to `admin_access_token` / `admin_refresh_token`.

**Body**: `email`, `password`.

**200** → `data: {access_token, refresh_token}`.

Current staff profile. **IsAdmin.**

**200** → `data`: `{id, email, name, phone, status, provider, avatar_url, is_active, is_staff, is_superuser, is_email_verified, last_active_at, created_at}`.

Update the staff profile (at least one field). **IsAdmin.** JSON or multipart.

**Body**: `name`, `avatar` (image), `clear_avatar` (bool).

Change the staff password. **IsAdmin.**

**Body**: `current_password`, `new_password` (min 8, must differ), `confirm_new_password` — all required.

Paginated end-user accounts (excludes staff/superusers). **IsSuperAdmin.**

**Query**: `search` (email/name/phone/city/country contains), `status` (repeatable or comma-separated: `ACTIVE|SUSPENDED|DEACTIVATED|PREMIUM`), `is_email_verified` (bool), `page`, `page_size`.

**200** → `data`: `{id, email, name, phone, avatar_url, country, city, timezone, status, provider, is_active, is_email_verified, last_active_at, created_at}` + `meta`.

item.name: Platform Config
item.description: Platform-wide configuration management.

request.description:
Update platform configuration. **IsSuperAdmin.** Accepts flat keys or nested `{section: {field}}` objects; JSON or multipart (logo). At least one field required.

**Fields**: `title`, `logo` (image), `favicon`, `support_email`, `privacy_policy`, `terms_of_service`, `data_deletion_policy`, `cookie_policy`, `is_vectorize_enabled`, `maintenance_mode`, `notify_banner_enabled`, `notify_banner_text` (≤500), `notify_banner_url`, `default_free_credits` (int), `monthly_free_credits` (int), `meta_title` (≤200), `meta_description`.

**200** → `data`: all config sections.

item.name: Subscription Plans
item.description: Plan CRUD. **IsSuperAdmin.** Base path: `/api/v1/admin/subscriptions/`.

request.description:
Create a subscription plan. Rule: if `ai_message_overage_enabled` is true, `ai_message_limit` must not be null.

**Body**: `name` (required), `plan_type`, `ai_message_limit` (int|null), `file_size_limit_mb`, `knowledge_chunk_limit`, `ai_message_overage_enabled` (bool), `features` (unique choice list), `details_html`, `is_free`, `is_public`, `requires_sales_contact`, `is_active`, `sort_order`.

**201** → `data`: full plan incl. `id`, `slug`, `created_by`, `updated_by`.
Update a plan. Supports PUT and PATCH. Same writable fields as create.

Delete a plan. **409** if referenced by subscriptions/payments.

**200** → `data: {id}`.

item.name: Analytics
item.description: Platform usage analytics. **IsSuperAdmin.** Base path: `/api/v1/admin/analytics/`.

request.description:
Aggregate AI usage/cost over an inclusive date range.

**Query**: `start_date`, `end_date` (`YYYY-MM-DD`, optional; `end_date >= start_date`).

**200** → `data`: `{total_message, total_cost, total_tokens, trip_planning {cost, tokens}, chat {cost, tokens}, trip_chat {cost, tokens}}`.

Sign-up growth series.

**Query**: `month` (`YYYY-MM`, optional — daily points for that month; otherwise the last 12 months).

**200** → `data`: `{granularity: month|day, points: [{period (YYYY-MM|YYYY-MM-DD), label, count}]}`.

query.description: Optional YYYY-MM; omit for last 12 months
